observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor room with blue painted walls and a light-colored floor, bare of furniture except for a corner pillar and red chairs visible at the edge
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving within a small indoor space, turning and changing orientation without traveling far
observation.posture: upright torso with flexible knee bends, weight shifting between feet and dropping into deep squats or kneeling positions
observation.footwork: barefoot stepping on the spot, tapping heels and toes, stepping side to side, and dropping onto knees on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive hand gestures near the face, pointing, holding one hand on hip while the other gestures, raising arms overhead with flicking wrist motions
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle torso sways, subtle hip shifts, and bending forward from the waist during squats and gestures
observation.levels_jumps_turns: vertical levels change from standing upright to deep squats, kneeling on both knees, and occasional gentle turns
observation.costume_and_props: yellow long-sleeved kurta top, black dhoti-style loose trousers, and a black sash tied around the waist; no hand props
observation.cannot_infer: exact acoustic details of live percussion versus synthesized tracks, exact foot strike dynamics due to soft studio audio mixing

signature_moments.what: stepping side to side with one hand on hip and the other index finger raised near the cheek in a thoughtful gesture
dropping gracefully to both knees on the floor while keeping one hand near the cheek and the other resting on the thigh
crouching low while sweeping hands near the floor in a circular motion
raising one arm overhead with a gentle wrist wave while tilting the head and holding the other arm akimbo
